results.build: not re-run (check+test green; build = check + vite build, gate inherited)

anchor_match: EXACT — matches portfolio-wide anchor (§8: 504 tests / 69 files green, svelte-check 0/0 across 383 files, DB_VERSION 4)

behavioural_baseline_to_preserve.hint: hint() reveals the from-square of the next expected user move; usedHint is NOT tracked; a hinted first-attempt solve grades a CLEAN win (full Glicko gain via gradeAttempt; FSRS Good/Easy via resultToGrade). THIS is the integrity defect T3 fixes.
behavioural_baseline_to_preserve.session_counters: solvedThisSession/attemptedThisSession are component-local, reset every mount; no persistence of training days / streak / daily goal.
behavioural_baseline_to_preserve.movetime: ms recorded per attempt; consumed ONLY by resultToGrade for the FSRS grade — no aggregate avg / fast+wrong pattern surfaced.
behavioural_baseline_to_preserve.study_plan: buildStudyPlan output is the AP-COACH-1 byte-identity invariant — it consumes leaks + weakest dimension, NEVER attempt ms or streak; T3 must not perturb it.
behavioural_baseline_to_preserve.dueReview: app.dueReview (boot + view-change) is the existing retention/re-engagement count (Home/Review badge).

doctrine_targets.no_db_version_bump: Retention fields (dailyStreak?, dailyGoal?, lastTrainedAt?) + usedHint? are additive-optional; mirror conceptSeen?/visionStats?/coachProfile? — NO DB_VERSION bump (bump schemaRev, backfill in load path).
doctrine_targets.pure_cores: Streak/clamp/impulsivity logic injects now (and a day-boundary fn) — no Date.now / Math.random in the cores (unit-testable per portfolio note: 'streak/clamp logic IS unit-testable').
doctrine_targets.bilingual: Every new user-facing string ships FR+EN via the catalogue (ADR-0053).
doctrine_targets.honesty: Impulsivity readout is descriptive (a fact sentence + descriptive word), NOT a grade — mirrors metacog AP-META-1.
doctrine_targets.no_component_test_harness: 0 *.svelte.test.ts; 504 tests are pure/logic. Verify T3 via pure-core unit tests (clamp + streak + impulsivity) + static wiring-presence + manual/preview — NOT component tests.
